text:
Omar: Onboarding zephyr-hybrid-13b (llama head layout + mistral-style rotary). After fast int4 conversion summaries start looping after ~10-15 tokens. FP16 baseline is fine. Suspect KV ordering or rotary freq/phase.
Nina: paste minimal repro + converter flags. Also which tokenizer build did you use? we've seen off-by-one sentinel ids before.
Omar: repro:```prompt='TL;DR: Quarterly update...'
ids=conv_tok.encode(prompt)
out=model.generate(ids, max_new_tokens=64, use_kv_cache=True)
print(out)```
Converter: zephyr-conv v3 --preserve-ids --emit-manifest. Quant: int4-avx per-channel bias-corr, act_order='proj_then_act', no calibration.
Jules: quick check: run identical FP16 artifact with kvcache=True and diff logits per token. If divergence appears right when cache is read that's ordering.
Omar: did that. Max abs diffs per token: 0,1e-6,2e-6,5e-5,0.09,0.14,0.2,0.53,... big jump at token 7-8.
Priya: signature looks like head-layout or rotary phase. Does converter manifest include \"head_interleave\" and \"rotary_scale\" fields? Runtime defaults might differ.
Omar: manifest: \"head_interleave\": \"auto\", \"rotary_scale\": \"1.0\", \"rotary_variant\": \"mistral-adapter\". Runtime printed rotary_scale=0.5 on load and assumed head_interleave=false.
Nina: mismatch there. Try (1) force runtime rotary_scale=1.0 and (2) force head_interleave=true on loader. If logits align earlier that's the bug. Also confirm token ids for sentinel tokens between tok versions.
Omar: quick experiments: setting rotary_scale=1.0 reduces repeats; setting head_interleave=true makes int4 logits match fp16 up to token 12. Token id diff check showed +1 on two sentinel ids when using older tokenizer binary.
Jules: plan: (A) patch converter to write explicit boolean head_interleave in manifest, (B) add loader assertion comparing manifest vs runtime default, (C) onboard CI smoke: load int4, generate 32 tokens on canonical prompt, compare top-1 token match to fp16 for first 8 tokens within epsilon.
loader-bot: Label applied: onboarding/zephyr-hybrid. Assigned: @Nina, @Jules. Please attach convert logs to onboarding board.
Priya: also add a small tokenizer id sanity check to convert pipeline (compare a few sentinel tokens and BOS/EOS) so older tok builds get a warning.
Omar: thanks — running a phase multiplier sweep now (+/- 0.25, 0.5) and will post numeric table and artifacts to board in ~30m.
